get.description: The closed query find in its short form: objects by type, trait, text, identifier or attribute. Attribute filters are filter[<attribute>][equals|in|prefix|range]. Hidden filters and filters on volatile attributes are refused.

parameters.name: kg
parameters.description: A KG id, a KG name, or main for the production KG.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: filter[<field>][<operation>]=<value>. Besides these fields, any attribute of the chosen type may be filtered.

object_type.description: Objects of this type; its subtypes too unless include_subtypes is false.

trait.description: Objects of a type that has this trait.

text.description: Objects whose display name or identifier contains this text.

scope_id.description: Not supported yet: refused with query_scope_unsupported.

parameters.name: include_subtypes
parameters.description: Whether subtypes of the chosen type match; default true.

parameters.name: kg_version_id
parameters.description: Read this sealed KG version (time travel).

parameters.name: change_seq
parameters.description: Read the state at this change number (time travel).

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: as_observed (default) or as_designed.

parameters.name: min_seq
parameters.description: Wait until this change number is readable.

parameters.name: wait_timeout
parameters.description: How long to wait for min_seq, an ISO 8601 duration such as PT5S.

parameters.name: max_staleness
parameters.description: Refuse the answer when its data is older than this, an ISO 8601 duration.

parameters.name: shape
parameters.description: items (default) or summary.
